title: Schema.org ContactPoint
description: A contact point, for example a customer service contact point.

contactType.description: A person or organization can have different contact points for different purposes (e.g., sales, technical support, billing).

areaServed.description: The geographic area where a service is provided.

availableLanguage.description: A language someone may use with or at the item.

contactOption.description: An option available on this contact point.

hoursAvailable.description: The hours during which this service is available.

productSupported.description: The product or service this support contact point is related to.

serviceArea.description: The geographic area where the service is provided.
